1.Na3 g6 2.g4.strategy: Grabs space on the kingside in the hope of a quick attack, but loosens White's own king and does nothing for the knight on the rim. Black answers by developing and striking in the centre, and the advanced pawn becomes a target rather than a spearhead.
1.Na3 g6 2.g4.name: Durkin Opening: Chenoboskion Variation
